description: Moirai processes land, crop and carbon information into model inputs, with development led by Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and the Joint Global Change Research Institute. Its C program combines raster and tabular sources, aggregates them to intersections of countries and user-defined geographic land units, and supplies R diagnostics. Default units include 235 global watersheds, while selected outputs can be recalibrated to a chosen reference year. The resulting land area, production, rent and carbon tables support agricultural, water and integrated-assessment simulations. Code is free under the repository modified BSD-3-Clause terms; bundled third-party inputs have separately documented ownership. Moirai complements GCAM by preparing land inputs, but its outputs can serve other models. A practical limitation is the documented 115 GB storage requirement for the full software and input collection and the need for the C NetCDF library. This review read metadata and instructions without retrieving the Git LFS files, building the program or validating derived land totals.
